Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.environments directly introduces shared.typing.environments. Defines slot descriptions and Γ together; links WF and normalized types. No give predicate is hidden here. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. SlotDescription is Option ValueType, distinguishing empty from absent lookup; Environment is a list with distinct variable keys. Environment.WellFormed requires Admissible (well-formed and normalized) inhabited descriptions. Replacement retains allocated variable keys, matching the freshness explanation. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
